exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Hi Marta, four changes before you build it. (1) Keep the 0-10 scale: NPS is defined on 0-10 (promoters 9-10, detractors 0-6) and Q3 was 0-10, so a 1-10 scale breaks the trend and the definition. (2) Q3 asks about support and implementation in one question; split it into two. (3) Q4 assumes the mobile app improved their month-end; ask first whether they use it, then 'How has it affected your month-end?' with a neutral scale including 'no change'. (4) The program samples admins and approvers; admins who logged in within 30 days skews to engaged users and will flatter the score. Send to all admins and approvers and accept a lower response rate. Leah
